_doc: Step 27 hardware catalog. SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for every latch / locator / seal / strut / control part. Millimetres. The build123d CAD (step27/cad/*.py) and the Blender render lane both read this file, so a vendor correction is one edit plus one rebuild.

_provenance_legend.DATASHEET: dimension read off a manufacturer drawing or catalogue; source_url + source_where given
_provenance_legend.DATASHEET_ARCHIVED: read off a Wayback capture of the manufacturer's own page (vendor site was down during this pass)
_provenance_legend.ESTIMATED: inferred envelope, NOT from a datasheet. Must be re-cut from vendor CAD before fabrication release.
_provenance_legend.CUSTOM: not purchased; a controlled custom part governed by our own drawing in step27/drawings/

_status_legend.SERIES_ONLY: series and part-number scheme resolved; the final dash number needs a vendor configurator input we do not have yet
_status_legend.NO_PART_REQUIRED: research resolved this to 'nothing to buy'

rotary_latch.role: Primary two-stage rotary (fork-bolt) latch. 8 in the side sockets (2 per socket) + 2 in the rear hatch. One PN for the whole product.
rotary_latch.pn_decode: R4 / 30 large / 4 = two-stage LH / 1 = 1/4-20 thread mount / 5 = bottom trigger / 0 / 1 = standard base / 20 = stainless steel passivated
rotary_latch.cable_base_variant: R4-30-42-503-20 (M6x1 mount, bottom lever, cable bracket, no return spring) - preferred for cable release; confirm the exact string with Southco
rotary_latch.source_where: Southco R4 catalogue pp.260, 300-302 (this revision carries the Performance Details the current media.southco.com revision drops)
rotary_latch.rated_load_note: 10 675 N (2 400 lbf) average ULTIMATE static (a failure load, Southco glossary); 14 230 N with support plate R4-38-101-10. Max DYNAMIC working load is 222 N (50 lb); Southco publishes no sustained rating. The service pull per latch is computed from the current geometry by checks_step27.service_load_per_latch (see checks.json latch_ultimate_sanity / latch_sustained_rating); the previous pass's 383 N was for the larger 640 x 353 socket and is withdrawn.

dims_provenance.why: Southco does not dimension the claw throat and renders the per-variant mounting-hole table as raster art. The internal mechanism modelled here is a REPRESENTATION sized to clear the Dia 12.7 striker; pull Southco's 2D/3D CAD before drawing release.

kinematics._note: REPRESENTATION (G6): the striker is fixed to the module and approaches along a STRAIGHT line at the closed bar height; the rotor receives at open_deg (its throat then faces that line), is driven through secondary_deg (first click) to closed_deg (second click) where the throat root wraps the bar. Southco does not dimension the internals.

rotary_latch.notes: MECHANICAL two-stage. NOT R4-EM (electronic). There is no R4-40 family - the real families are R4-05/10/15/20/25/30/50/81/82.
rotary_latch.representation_note: Step 27 styling pass: internal mechanism re-represented so it is physically realisable - throat depth 10 -> 7 mm puts the striker-bar centre 8 mm from the rotor pivot instead of 5 mm (at 5 mm the Dia 12.7 bar enclosed the pivot pin); the pawl now lies inside the housing (it previously protruded 16 mm through the mounting panel) and the housing is two slotted side plates the bar passes through. Envelope, hole pitch and panel thickness remain Southco DATASHEET values; the internals remain a REPRESENTATION (G6).
rotary_latch.trigger_interface: Southco R4 literature p.323: bottom trigger takes retainer clip R4-0-43922-2; trigger/lever cable-clip hole 6.3 mm, trigger/lever thickness 4 mm.

load_definitions.southco_definition: 'The load that causes failure or excessive deformation which renders the product inoperable.' (Southco glossary, archived 2022-05-16)
load_definitions.needs_vendor: Rated sustained (primary-latched) working load of R4-30-41-501-20 in our pull direction, with and without R4-38-101-10.

striker.role: Striker bolt the fork bolt captures. The Dia 12.7 shoulder IS the bar.
striker.alt_pn: R4-90-324-20 (recessed 6 mm hex head, where the hex head would foul)
striker.notes: Mounted through a slotted bracket on the module / hatch leaf so the tolerance stack is dialled out at fit-up instead of scrapped.

release_cable.role: Push-pull remote release: one handle -> splitter -> both rotary latches in a socket.
release_cable.pn_scheme: AC-C[actuator-end][latch-end][spring]-[cable type]-[length mm, 4 digits]-[extension mm, 3 digits]. K = stainless L-fitting, 9 = jacketed snub/snub (mechanical R4), 0 = no spring.
release_cable.source_where: Southco AC cable literature, catalogue pp.321-323

dims_provenance.why: Southco publishes the minimum bend radius (50.8 mm) and the construction (stainless cable, Acetal liner, polypropylene jacket) but NOT the conduit OD. Take it from the Cable Selection Tool before routing is released.

release_cable.open: NEEDS SOUTHCO: fitting letters for AC-75-101-11 / AC-05-301-11 and the R4-30 bottom trigger with R4-0-43922-2, TA from the actuator J drawing, type-9 availability at 0450/0650, conduit OD.
release_cable.qty_note: Southco's splitter diagram (AC-CA p.321) is one cable in from the handle and two out to the latches: 5 handle+splitter sets (4 sockets + hatch) = 5 handle-to-splitter + 10 splitter-to-latch = 15.
release_cable.pn_placeholder_note: Placeholder only. TTT (extension) = TA + TLC + TF per Southco drawing J-AC-C; with a K latch-end fitting TF = 20.32 so TTT >= 020 - the previous '-000' was impossible. Type 9 at 0450/0650 mm, the actuator/latch fitting letters and the conduit OD are not public (Cable Selection Tool is not reachable without a browser): NEEDS SOUTHCO.

release_handle.role: Interior one-hand release, one per socket plus one for the hatch. PURCHASED - the earlier custom bell-crank lever is deleted; Southco already sells the splitter that does the job.
release_handle.alt_pn: AC-80-101-11 (surface-mount pull T-handle, Dia 32 double-D hole, 64.6 x 56 mm, 13.7 mm travel)
release_handle.splitter_role: one handle -> two latches; this is why no custom lever is needed
release_handle.source_where: Southco AC catalogue p.317 (handle), p.321 (splitter), p.319 (bracket)

locating_pin_round.role: Primary locator, module flange -> socket land.
locating_pin_round.source_where: MISUMI series 110300557320 'Large Head Locating Pin - Round/Diamond Head, Tapered Tip, Straight Shank, P/L/B Configurable'; PN validated completeFlag=1 by MISUMI's public part-number service on 2026-09-27 (out-of-range controls rejected); drawing drw_01_001.gif; 2019 catalogue pp.1544-1545
locating_pin_round.material_options: O1 tool steel (default) / SKS3 (B) / 304 stainless (S) / 440C 50-55 HRC (C). Specify 440C or 304 against CFRP.
locating_pin_round.pn_grammar: [Type CFP = 440C/420 SS 50-55 HRC][BPA round p6 | BPD diamond p6][D shank]-P[head dia]-L[shank length]-B[straight head length]

dims_provenance.why: Values from MISUMI's live series data + drawing for the D=6 row, P=10, L=10, B=8. The previous pass's Dia 14 x 8 shoulder, 6 x 12 shank and 4 mm diamond width came from the wrong row/series and are withdrawn: this Large Head pin seats on its head, it has no separate shoulder.

locating_pin_round.note: 440C chosen over O1 (FPBPA/FPBPD) for an outdoor product; FP (O1, 60-63 HRC) is the harder alternative if corrosion is managed.

locating_pin_diamond.role: Secondary locator: takes rotation without over-constraining the pair.
locating_pin_diamond.source_where: MISUMI series 110300557320 'Large Head Locating Pin - Round/Diamond Head, Tapered Tip, Straight Shank, P/L/B Configurable'; PN validated completeFlag=1 by MISUMI's public part-number service on 2026-09-27 (out-of-range controls rejected); drawing drw_01_001.gif; 2019 catalogue pp.1544-1545
locating_pin_diamond.pn_grammar: [Type CFP = 440C/420 SS 50-55 HRC][BPA round p6 | BPD diamond p6][D shank]-P[head dia]-L[shank length]-B[straight head length]

dims_provenance.why: Values from MISUMI's live series data + drawing for the D=6 row, P=10, L=10, B=8. The previous pass's Dia 14 x 8 shoulder, 6 x 12 shank and 4 mm diamond width came from the wrong row/series and are withdrawn: this Large Head pin seats on its head, it has no separate shoulder.

locating_pin_diamond.note: 440C chosen over O1 (FPBPA/FPBPD) for an outdoor product; FP (O1, 60-63 HRC) is the harder alternative if corrosion is managed.

bushing.role: Press-fit hardened bushing receiving the locating pins.

fit.press_into: H7 bore in the 6061 socket frame

bushing.correction: The earlier spec called for a 10 mm H7 bore. MISUMI states H7 is only offered at d = 2-6; at d = 10 every JBH/JBHU variant is G6. Re-specified to 10 G6 (5-24 micron diametral clearance), which is what MISUMI intends to pair with their pin heads. Do not carry '10 H7' anywhere.
bushing.source_where: MISUMI series 110302666420 'Bushings for Locating Pins - Flanged'; PN validated completeFlag=1 on 2026-09-27; drawing drw_01.gif; 2019 catalogue pp.1682-1683
bushing.pn_grammar: [JBH O1 | JBHN O1+Ni | JBHC 440C/420 SS][d]-[L under the flange]
bushing.correction_2: The '15' in JBHC10-15 is the length under the flange (L), not the OD; overall 19 mm. The previous 16 mm length is withdrawn.

gas_strut.role: Rear hatch lift support, 2 off, selected by hatch.solve_struts from the Standard Program p.17 table
gas_strut.source_where: Standard Program EN p.17, LIFT-O-MAT HD series 6-15, ball socket / ball socket

installed_geometry.note: Solved, not placed. Step 29 (task 139737): the full-height hatch (1000 x 292 aperture, leaf 1052 x 344, no fixed bottom run) raised the leaf 3.28 -> 3.75 kg; 6462II (120 stroke) no longer solves, so hatch.solve_struts selected 6467IK (50 N, 150 stroke, extended 375.5). checks_step27.check_struts re-derives these numbers from the geometry.

alternates.why: same envelope at 200 N if the built leaf is heavier than the estimate

gas_strut.notes: Force is re-selected after the first leaf is weighed; the 200 N alternate shares the envelope, so no bracket changes.
gas_strut.catalogue_6_15_source: Stabilus Standard Program EN (PDF created 2026-04-22) p.17, LIFT-O-MAT HD 6-15, forces 50-200 N transcribed; sha256 59571c7175fa5c819481908596b390e91a19fed1a449bf3ab8669592b2a9e312
gas_strut.ref_columns_resolved: The two Ref.-No. columns are legended by the page's own drawing callouts: column 1 = strut with 18 mm ball sockets (13.3 across) for ball studs to DIN 71803 Dia 10; column 2 = the same strut with the socket fitted with an M8 x 13, SW13 ball stud (12 mm to the ball). Order column 1 + 4486MD studs, or column 2 alone.
gas_strut.selection_history: Previous pass: 6541IS (150 N) for a 1.28 x 0.41 m leaf on a 640 mm-tall shell. The cab-height shell gives a 1.0 x 0.25 m aperture and a 3.5 kg leaf; 150 N would be ~3x over-sprung. | Step 27 rev 10: 6462II (50 N, 120 stroke) for a 3.28 kg leaf. Step 29: 6467IK (50 N, 150 stroke) for the 3.75 kg full-height leaf.
gas_strut.open_note: The 'Dia 10 ball' convention: the page states the sockets suit ball studs to DIN 71803 Dia 10 and column 2 fits M8 SW13 studs; our drawing calls M8 explicitly. No 316 stainless variant was selected.

hinge.role: Rear hatch concealed hinge, 2 off (a third is recommended), 95 deg swing.
hinge.alt_pn: GN 7237-NI-50-L/R-MT (180 deg, same loads, needs a separate 95 deg stop)
hinge.material: AISI 304, matte tumbled; self-lubricating bronze bearing
hinge.CRITICAL: GN 7233 is a MULTI-JOINT LINKAGE, not a fixed-pivot butt hinge. There is no single hinge-axis offset; the leaf follows a coupler curve. Our CAD models a PURE ROTATION about a nominal design axis as the design intent, and checks that the leaf stays inside the published installation-space envelope (l4 x l5, radius r, offsets x/y). The true path MUST be re-checked against JW Winco's free 2D/3D CAD before any drawing is released. This is a named OPEN item, not a solved one.
hinge.load_check: Leaf ~5-7 kg = 50-70 N carried radially; one size-50 pair is rated 750 N radial, >10x. JW Winco publishes NO dynamic or shock rating, and on a vehicle road fatigue is the real constraint - the datasheet permits a third hinge and we should fit one.
hinge.open: PDF vs HTML dimension conflict at size 50: PDF gives d=6.5 / h1=10, the HTML table gives 6.6 / 11.9. PDF treated as authoritative; verify before cutting.

t_handle.role: Keyed T-handle compression latch. Rear hatch (adjustable grip) + toolbox door (fixed grip), key-alike.
t_handle.source_where: Southco E3 VISE ACTION catalogue pp.90-121 (scheme p.93, dimensions p.92)
t_handle.sealing: NEMA 4 / IP65, and ONLY with the optional E5-17 flange gasket. IP67 is NOT available on the keyed T-handle body.
t_handle.keying: Head style 8 ships keyed alike CH751 by default, so a production run shares one key with no option code. There is no key-code field in the E3 part number.
t_handle.open: GRIP MISMATCH (found 2026-09-27): E3-18-15 grip 11.4-27.2 mm, but the flush hatch stack (26 leaf + 20.25 seal + 6 land) is 52.25 mm, so the cam cannot reach a keeper behind the surround. Re-select a keyed lock with a keeper standoff or longer grip. Also: no keyed T-handle exists in stainless E3; CH751 code from the 2011 catalogue revision - confirm with Southco.

bulb_seal.role: EPDM bulb seal on every socket land and the hatch surround. One profile, one PN, whole product.
bulb_seal.alt_pn: DD6138 (side bulb, same base and grip range)
bulb_seal.second_source: Fairchild Industries TS1014 - dimensionally identical to DD6138 (.438 bulb, .505 carrier H, .755 W, grips .060-.125)
bulb_seal.source_where: Trim-Lok co-extruded Trim Seal catalogue p.23; material spec at https://www.trimlok.com/secure/content/documents/coextrudedtrimsealspecsheet.pdf
bulb_seal.mount: PUSH-ON U-CHANNEL over a machined retention rib. NOT a groove seal - the earlier groove design is superseded.
bulb_seal.sizing_rule: Trim-Lok's own published rule (catalogue p.18): 1.5 x closed gap = bulb OD. 11.13 / 1.5 = 7.42 mm design gap, i.e. 33 % bulb deflection. Their Rubber Seal spec sheet separately recommends 25 % for maximum life; we sit between.
bulb_seal.material: bulb = custom EPDM sponge, medium-firm; base = dense EPDM 70 Shore A; carrier = flexible aluminium wire. -40 F to +212 F. FMVSS 302, UL94HB, FAA/FAR 23.853(a), UL50E MH49032.
bulb_seal.open: Trim-Lok publishes no compression-force curve for the DD co-extruded family. If a force number is needed, the Specialty Trim Seal combos (e.g. 105B100B3X1/8A at 0.822 lb/in at 25 %) are the only bulb-on-channel products with published force data. DD6138/DD6139 are catalogue/RFQ parts with no web cart - order through a rep.

compression_limiter.role: UHMW pad that sets the metal-to-metal stop so the seal is compressed a controlled 33 % and cannot be crushed.
compression_limiter.stock: 3/8 in (9.5 mm) UHMW sheet, machined to 7.40 mm
compression_limiter.material_source: U.S. Plastic Corp UHMW sheet (item 29170 is the verified 1/8 in listing; the 3/8 in item number is not yet confirmed)
compression_limiter.process: waterjet blank + surface grind to thickness
compression_limiter.critical_tol: thickness 7.40 +0 / -0.05 - this dimension IS the seal compression
compression_limiter.open: McMaster part numbers could not be resolved (mcmaster.com now requires a login for all product tables). The U.S. Plastic 3/8 in sheet item number still needs confirming.

ball_plunger.role: Anti-chatter preload at the module plug.
ball_plunger.alt_pn: Elesa+Ganter GN 615-M8-KN (GN.33133), AISI 303, 31 N max load
ball_plunger.source_where: McMaster ball-nose spring plungers; Elesa GN 615-NI datasheet https://www.elesa.com/siteassets/PDF/PDF_US/GN%20615-NI.pdf
ball_plunger.housing_fit: H7 bore per the Elesa datasheet note

chmsl.role: Secondary centre high-mount stop lamp on the hatch leaf. REQUIRED, not optional: Upfitting Guide p.65 makes the upfitter responsible for FMVSS 108 secondary lighting when an upfit blocks the OEM CHMSL, and a topper does.
chmsl.alt_pn: Grote 01-5444-75 (412 x 52 x 22, 340 mm hole pattern) - marked SAE U, i.e. SUPPLEMENTAL only, NOT a legal CHMSL on its own
chmsl.source_where: Corroborated across three independent distributors; Maxxima publishes no fetchable PDF
chmsl.compliance_detail: SAE J1957 / J2042 / J592, function codes P2 P3 U3. U3 is the CHMSL function code. J1957 is the CHMSL standard for vehicles under 2032 mm wide, which a pickup is. A lamp marked only 'SAE U' (J186) is supplemental and is NOT a legal CHMSL.
chmsl.open: Nothing SAE-J1957/U3-marked exists in the 250-350 mm window originally wanted; 394 mm is the shortest compliant bar found. Confirm the U3 marking on the physical lens before cutting the pocket, and resolve the housing-material conflict between distributors.

tailgate_switch.role: Gen-1 R1T OEM controls the topper must not disable. SEE TAILGATE_CONTROL.md.
tailgate_switch.source_where: Owner's Guide MY22-24 pp.16, 283-284; Upfitting Guide pp.56-57, 65, 100-102

findings.release_type: electric latch release only; gravity drop; damped descent; manual close
findings.primary_switch_location: TOP face of the DRIVER-side bed rail cap, rear end, flush in a moulded recess
findings.primary_switch_is_dual_function: also the only in-bed bed-light toggle
findings.entrapment_button_location: inside the bed, PASSENGER inner wall, under the rail lip, rear

tailgate_switch.topper_integration: MECHANICAL preservation: sealed access wells through the topper base rail over each covered OEM button. NO splice, NO relocation, NO added switch.
tailgate_switch.notes: Rivian publishes no dimensioned button position; well X positions are provisional pending tape gaps T1-T5 in TAILGATE_CONTROL.md.

oem_control_well.role: Sealed access well through the topper base rail so an OEM rail-top button stays pressable.
oem_control_well.process: CNC pocket in the base-rail extrusion; lid compression-moulded from the module-flange tool offcut
oem_control_well.finish: black anodise Type II (rail) / UV clear (lid)
oem_control_well.critical_tol: land flatness 0.2 so the DD6139 seal grips evenly
oem_control_well.notes: Drain discharges OUTBOARD onto the OEM rail cap, outside our seal line.

harness_tap.role: Sanctioned 12 V upfitter feed for the topper (secondary CHMSL, interior light, optional cage fan).

electrical.wire_min: 14 AWG (2.5 mm2) PVC or 16 AWG (1.5 mm2) XLPE

harness_tap.open: Pin count / pinout NOT published by Rivian. Resolve from the Aptiv catalogue for 13897598 or Service Manual LC 781013010 before releasing the harness drawing.

_deleted.release_lever: Deleted 2026-09-27. The earlier CUSTOM bell-crank lever existed only to pull two cables with equal travel. Southco already sells exactly that: AC-05-301-11 splitter + AC-75-101-11 paddle. One fewer custom part, one fewer drawing, one fewer tolerance.

port_adapter.role: DOCUMENTED FALLBACK, NOT IN THE PRIMARY BOM (rev 11). Rev 10 bolted each station to this purchased adapter with an M10 stud/nut/Nord-Lock stack. That is an assumed bolt interface, NOT the Rivian crossbar mechanism (operator card 2081357), so it was replaced by the Port Latch Foot. Kept only as an option if the PLF is abandoned or P-CAL-01b shows the port cannot take a crossbar-style foot. Latches into the OEM port without modifying it and presents an M10 female thread. 4 off if used.
port_adapter.source_where: Product page retrieved 2026-10-02: SKU 09-111-00078-7, 'Sold individually', 'R1T needs 4 for the bed and 4 for the roof', 'accept any roof/bed rack or accessory that has mounting brackets using M10 bolts', 'Billet 6061 aluminum construction with clear anodize, 5-axis CNC machined', 'No permanent modification to accessory ports required'. Fitment listed: R1T Gen 1 2021-2024.
port_adapter.alt_pn: Mars Adventure Gear 'Accessory Port Adapter (Rivian)' - converts a port into TWO M8 threaded points (marsag.co/products/accessory-port-adapter-rivian). Not selected: a two-point M8 pattern would need a second station drawing; kept as the second source.
port_adapter.port_rating_source: R1T Upfitting Guide 2025-09-24 p.59: 'Accessory ports are designed to withstand a maximum of 2,500 Newtons (N) or 551 lb (250 kg) per port ... the safety threshold for how much load can be placed on the port without causing damage.'

dims_provenance.why: Weistec publishes no drawing. The station is designed around a PROVISIONAL envelope (blender/params.json mount.adapter_*) and the M10 thread the vendor states; capture the real part (P-CAL-01) and re-run before the station drawing is released.

port_adapter.calibration: P-CAL-01: on receipt, measure above-cap height, footprint, M10 thread depth and its position relative to the port centre with the adapter latched on the truck; set mount.adapter_* and re-run assembly/checks. Shim range 0-2 mm absorbs +/-1 mm of height without a re-cut.

port_latch_foot.role: Topper-to-truck anchor, 4 off (2 per rail cap): a Rivian-crossbar-style Port Latch Foot. Machined body drops into the OEM accessory port through the shell foot pocket; a comb slider with two hook teeth (25 mm apart, provisional) slides under the port's dual-barrel latch-pin pair; a hinged paddle on the INBOARD face closes over a key lock cylinder; two detent stages (stage 1 caught, stage 2 closed). Field removal: unlock x4, lift paddles, lift the topper - the same user experience as removing Rivian crossbars. The topper's rail is fastened to the body at the shop with ordinary M6 screws (topper off the truck).
port_latch_foot.manufacturer: CUSTOM (our drawings DWG-27-012 body, DWG-27-013 paddle + hook slider + shim)
port_latch_foot.mechanism_source: Rivian R1T Owner's Guide 2022-10-17 p.152-154 (two clicks, paddle, key lock under the paddle, latch tuning); Upfitting Guide 2025-09-24 p.59 (2,500 N per port, two anchor marks per port); trailrivian.com crossbar install thread; Team 1EV 'dual-barrel' mounting link; Mars Adventure Gear port adapter (two M8 points 25 mm apart). Full list with URLs and fetch dates: step27/research/PORT_MECHANISM_SOURCES.md
port_latch_foot.port_rating_source: R1T Upfitting Guide 2025-09-24 p.59: 'Accessory ports are designed to withstand a maximum of 2,500 Newtons (N) or 551 lb (250 kg) per port ... the safety threshold for how much load can be placed on the port without causing damage.' Rivian forbids modifying the ports.

ESTIMATED: pin_d, pin_len, pin_pitch (25 mm from Mars Adventure Gear), pin_u, pin_z (latch-pin pair)
stem_*, head_*, flange_*, slot_*, chan_*, bar_*, tooth_*, slider_travel (hook geometry)
hinge_*, paddle_*, knuckle_d, ear_*, detent_* (paddle and detent)
dims_provenance.why: Rivian publishes neither the accessory-port internals (cleat / latch-pin dimensions, recess size, depth) nor the crossbar-foot drawing. The foot is designed around a PROVISIONAL port envelope in blender/params.json mount.*; every dimension that touches the port is flagged by the OPEN check plf_port_internals_P-CAL-01b.

port_latch_foot.calibration: P-CAL-01b: buy ONE Rivian Cargo Crossbars set (crossbar_reference) as the reference article. Photograph and measure the crossbar foot (hook / tang, paddle, lock position, latch-tuning screw) and, on a real truck, the port (recess L x W x depth, cleat / pin positions, pin diameter, pin pitch). Set mount.port_* / pin_* / hook_* and re-run assembly + checks before any station drawing is released. Never modify the truck port (Rivian).
port_latch_foot.tolerances: seat flange top 4.00 +0/-0.05 above the cap (pad stop); hook tooth top faces ground flat 0.02 and 'pin-bottom' datum -18.00 +/-0.05 from the cap; slider-slot floor/roof parallel 0.03; hinge bores 5.00 H7, ears coaxial 0.03; lock bore 19.2 H11.
port_latch_foot.material_process: Body 6061-T6 5-axis CNC, hard anodise Type III; paddle 6061-T6 CNC, black anodise Type II; hook slider 17-4 PH H1025 wire-EDM + ground, passivated; hinge pin A4 dowel; 1.0 mm 316 shims laser-cut.

plf_lock.role: Key lock cylinder under the closed paddle (Rivian crossbar lock position). Keyed alike so ONE key opens all four stations (as the Rivian crossbar set ships 2 locking keys). Cam interlock with the paddle's keeper is NOT drawn (P-CAL-01b); the cylinder envelope and its cam pocket are.
plf_lock.source_where: Amazon listing 'CompX National Cam Lock w/ 2 Keys - Keyed Alike to C346A  C8053-C346A-14A', $13.77, retrieved 2026-10-06 (third-party seller; listing text: 90 deg cam turn, key removable in both locked and unlocked positions, supplied with two keys, trim washer, spur washer, mounting nut and two cams; 1 13/16 in max panel; sibling listings show the 1-3/16 in cylinder-length variant of the same C8053 family). Disc-tumbler key blank CompX National D8785 per the listing.
plf_lock.alt_pn: C8053-C420A-14A (same family, key code C420A, Amazon ASIN B01CV16UU4, $11.87, 2026-10-06)

dims_provenance.why: Cylinder length 1-3/16 in (30.2 mm overall) is from the listing family; diameters, flange and cam size are NOT read off a CompX drawing (the C8053 drawing was not retrieved). Re-cut the lock bore from the received part. The cam is trimmed to ~20 mm by the shop (the stock straight cam is 1-1/2 in).

plf_lock.open: Cam interlock with the paddle keeper and the exact cylinder dimensions: confirm on the received part (P-CAL-01b).

plf_detent.role: Spring-loaded ball-nose plunger that gives the paddle its two detents (stage 1 = click 1, closed = click 2). One per station, in the +x hinge ear, ball on two dimples in the paddle knuckle end; the open position is the cam-link over-travel limit, not a detent.
plf_detent.source_where: Same plunger as 'ball_plunger' (M8x1.25, 16 mm body, 4.5 mm ball, 1.5 mm extension; 15.1-29.8 N). Detent force and dimple depth are NOT tuned: P-CAL-01b / prototype.

crossbar_reference.role: REFERENCE ARTICLE for calibration P-CAL-01b, not a product part: one Rivian R1 Cargo Crossbars set bought, measured, photographed and returned/kept to calibrate the Port Latch Foot (hook, paddle, lock position, tuning screw) and, on the truck, the port. Within Rivian's 30-day return policy the set can be returned in original condition if it is not opened beyond measurement - Nate's call.
crossbar_reference.pn: R1 Cargo Crossbars (Bright) - no SKU shown on the page
crossbar_reference.source_where: Gear Shop page fetched 2026-10-06: Bright $700 / Dark $800; telescoping 68-82 in; 28 lb; height 4.25 in; 'Telescoping fit for roof and bed rail'; 'One-handed snap-on design'; 'The included lock system securely fastens the crossbars to your accessory ports'; 'Equipped with Rivian Adventure Key Set'; fits R1T R1S. Installation guide linked from the page.

foot_pad.role: Foot-to-paint pad and anti-rattle under the shell foot on each bed-rail cap. Closed-cell so it does not wick; 33 % nominal compression set by the PLF seat-flange stop (rev 11).
foot_pad.manufacturer: spec: ASTM D1056 Type 2 Class B Grade 2 (2B2) closed-cell EPDM sponge, 6.35 mm (1/4 in), PSA one side
foot_pad.pn: see pricing file (vendor PN for 2B2 EPDM 1/4 in x 4 in PSA strip)
foot_pad.source_where: ASTM D1056 grade 2B2 = 2-5 psi (14-34 kPa) compression-deflection at 25 %; any vendor certifying 2B2 is interchangeable.

STUD_M10x60_A4.standard: DIN 976-1 stud cut from DIN 975 A4-70 rod
STUD_M10x60_A4.role: FALLBACK only (Weistec adapter option), not in the rev-11 joint schedule: port station stud, Loctite 243 into the Weistec adapter

NUT_M10_A4.role: FALLBACK only (Weistec adapter option), not in the rev-11 joint schedule: port station nut, 30 Nm

NL10SS.role: FALLBACK only (Weistec adapter option), not in the rev-11 joint schedule: port clamp lock
NL10SS.note: t/OD/ID to be confirmed from the Nord-Lock datasheet for the ordered article

SHCS_M6x30_A4.role: PLF rail screw: rail strip <- PLF body (2 per station, in shear), shimmed

SSCREW_M6x20_A4.standard: ISO 4026 (hex socket set screw, flat point)
SSCREW_M6x20_A4.role: PLF latch-tuning / paddle closed-stop screw (1 per station)

PIN_DOWEL_5x80_A4.role: PLF paddle hinge pin (1 per station)

SHCS_1/4-20x5/8_316.standard: ASME B18.3 socket head cap screw
SHCS_1/4-20x5/8_316.role: R4-30 latch to carrier plate (R4-30-41-501-20 = 1/4-20 thread mount option 1)

FHCS_M6x12_A4.role: UHMW limiter pad to frame boss

BHCS_M6x16_A4.role: GN 7233 hinge brackets (d = 6.5 holes) to surround / leaf blocks

BHCS_M5x10_A4.role: toolbox tub flange to plug frame

BHCS_M4x12_A4.role: release handle (2x Dia 4.5 thru), splitter, CHMSL (Dia 4.8), glazing retainers

structural_adhesive.role: Every bonded joint: socket frames, hatch surround, base rails to foot, roof hardpoints, leaf bosses/blocks, potted inserts.
structural_adhesive.note: Surface prep: abrade + solvent wipe CFRP; anodised 6061 bond faces masked from anodise or primed per 3M guidance. Coverage computed from modelled bond areas (fasteners.bond_area_m2).

glazing_tape.role: WINDOW module pane to plug-frame flange (PC is stress-crack sensitive to epoxies).

threadlocker.role: Strikers, ball studs, ball plungers, hinge and latch screws, PLF tuning screw (the rail screws take Loctite 243 once the shim pack is set).

anti_seize.role: Stainless into aluminium threads (PLF rail screws and tuning screw into 6061, A4 into tapped 6061 elsewhere): galling and galvanic isolation.

mounting._doc: Engineering inputs for checks_step27.check_mounting. Stated design assumptions - not a standard, not FEA. accel_g is the inertial+gravity load ON the topper in g, vehicle frame (X rearward, Y driver, Z up); gravity is the -1 in z. Rev 11: the stud/nut/torque/slip inputs of rev 10 are gone (no bolt joint at the port); PLF inputs are 'plf_strength' and 'rail_screw_torque_Nm'.

load_cases.name: LC2 rebound + highway lift
load_cases.note: +1 g net upward (2 g up acceleration less gravity) plus 600 N lift: 0.5*1.225*(36.1 m/s)^2 * 2.3 m^2 plan * CL 0.3 = 550 N, rounded up

load_cases.name: LC3 braking
load_cases.note: 1 g braking: inertia throws the topper FORWARD (-x; X is rearward).

load_cases.name: LC6 forward crash pulse
load_cases.note: Not a regulatory case: there is none for a cap. Reported against the 2,500 N rating as information, with friction slip and bolt shear as the governing checks.

mounting.benchmark: Rivian Cargo Crossbars on 4 roof ports: 113 kg dynamic per pair (R1T Owner's Guide p.359 / Upfitting Guide p.59). Used as an independent cross-check of the per-4-port dynamic allowance.
mounting.rail_screw_torque_source: A4-70 M6 into tapped 6061 (soft joint): 6 Nm, consistent with J06 (Upfit p.57 M6 table, soft-joint column, A4-70 ~75 %).

plf_strength._doc: Stated material values for the assumption-level PLF checks (ESTIMATED - from memory of typical handbook values, not mill certs; verify before release).
plf_strength.hook_load_sharing: 2 teeth per station share the load equally; port load limit 2,500 N
